name: Dire Maul

entrance.note: Broken Dire Maul campus west of Camp Mojache. East, West, and North are separate wings with their own portals on the courtyard. Coordinates from research/dungeons/dungeons.json (Questie dungeons.lua).

travel.how: Fly Camp Mojache and ride northwest along the road to the Dire Maul ruins (59.2, 45.1). Do East first if you still need the Crescent Key for West and North.

keys.name: Crescent Key
keys.from: Pusillin in Dire Maul East (chase him to the end of the wing; 7441 from Azj'Tordin at Lariss Pavilion)
keys.opens: Dire Maul West door and Dire Maul North door
keys.note: East wing first on a leveling trip if anyone in the group still needs West or North. The key is unique per character.

keys.name: Gordok Courtyard Key
keys.from: Guard Mol'dar / Slip'kik / Fengus on a North (tribute or kill) run
keys.opens: Gordok courtyard gates in Dire Maul North
keys.note: Tribute runs skip the king and keep this key path intact.

keys.name: Gordok Inner Door Key
keys.from: Guard Slip'kik or the North wing ogre key holders
keys.opens: Inner North doors toward Captain Kromcrush / King Gordok
keys.note: Not required for East or West.

keys.name: Gordok Shackle Key
keys.from: Gordok ogres in Dire Maul North
keys.note: Required set includes 5525; loot the key during the North clear.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 55-60; run at 58. Treat East, West, and North as separate instances. East is the fast Lethtendris / Pusillin / Crescent Key wing.
warnings: Pick up 7489 and 7481 in Camp Mojache and 7441 at Lariss Pavilion (76.9, 37.4) before you ride to the ruins.
East first for the Crescent Key if you still need West (Immol'thar) or North (Knot / tribute).
West pylons need the group to stay together; drink after each pylon.
Skip tribute extras (Broken Trap mats, ogre suit cloth, Unfinished Gordok Business) unless the group is already doing a tribute run.
Skip class librams unless that class is in the group; skip Quel'Serrar, Dreadsteed, and Dungeon Set 2.
classQuests: Dire Maul class librams 7498-7506 (Rogue, Warrior, Mage, Paladin, Warlock, Hunter, Priest, Shaman, Druid) — item-start inside, skip other classes.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Everlook Winterfall and elite hunts in horde-40-60.route.json are the slow same-band outdoor XP a Dire Maul East+West run at 58 replaces.
Cenarion Hold openers in horde-40-60.route.json (Securing the Supply Lines, Deadly Desert Venom) sit in the same band as Dire Maul.

notes: Horde-only leveling dossier. Pickup hubs are Camp Mojache and the Dire Maul entrance (plus Lariss Pavilion for Pusillin). Wings: East (Lethtendris, Crescent Key), West (Immol'thar / Shen'dralar), North (Gordok / Knot / tribute). Dungeons-off replacement: Feralas, Winterspring and Silithus. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db.
